Job Title: Software Engineering Intern
Company: TechNova Solutions (fictional)

Responsibilities: Assist the backend development team in writing, testing, and debugging Python code. Collaborate on building internal REST APIs, participate in daily stand-up meetings, and document code changes.

Requirements: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Experience with Python and basic knowledge of Git version control. Must be detail-oriented and eager to learn in a fast-paced agile environment.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you had to learn a new tool, language, or concept quickly for a class or project. How did you approach it, and what was the result?
questions.what_they_look_for: Evidence of eagerness to learn and a practical self-directed learning approach, which fits a fast-paced agile environment.

questions.question: Suppose you are building a simple internal REST API in Python that lets a team look up, add, and update employee records. Which HTTP methods and endpoints would you use, and what would you do to test that it works correctly?
questions.what_they_look_for: Basic understanding of REST concepts, HTTP methods, and a sensible approach to testing and debugging Python code.

questions.question: Imagine you've finished a code change and pushed it with Git, and during stand-up the next day a teammate says your change broke something they were working on. How would you respond, and what steps would you take afterward, including documenting the fix?
questions.what_they_look_for: Collaboration, ownership, attention to detail, comfort with Git, and good communication and documentation habits.
